name: suede-customer-research
description: Suede AI customer-research discipline: interview design, transcript, ticket, survey, and NPS synthesis, review and forum mining with saved captures, VOC quote banks, jobs to be done, evidence-backed personas, and the exact questions buyers type into search and AI assistants. Use when discovering or synthesizing what a defined customer segment actually says, does, needs, and resists. NOT FOR: competitor-only profiling (use suede-competitor-profiling), writing final marketing copy (use suede-copy)
author: JasonColapietro
